body: This should probably be imported into algolia/satellite as well.

I think the SVG icons could be moved to a file called `icons.tsx`, like I did with the chat icons. We could even put all the icons in a single file at the root of the package. It would also be good to check Lucide (https://lucide.dev/icons/) to see if they have similar icons. That way, all of the icons we use would come from the same library.

body: I think we need to reuse or update the common CSS variables in `packages/instantsearch.css/src/shared/_variables.scss`, This way, we could have a dark mode for autocomplete too. We can also add autocomplete-specific CSS variables to this file, as I did for the chat-specific ones.
We have CSS variables for transition duration and easing function

I specifically chose not to because autocomplete is really integrated with other components which don't have a dark mode, thought it would look strange to have only one widget with dark mode :/ 
It works for chat cause it's just a floating action button and is a floating window, but for autocomplete I'm afraid we should really take time to have a dark mode theme for all widgets
I put them in a separate file. Using lucide could be nice yes, but we should probably do this for all icons at some point
